referenceRoles.staging: User-provided desk/distraction reference; no reference watermark or UI copied

prompts.A:
Create ONE complete, polished pixel-art narrative illustration for a 16:9 video frame (landscape, ideally 1536x864 or 1920x1080). Reference image 1 is ONLY the approved character identity: warm brown tousled hair, rounded face, mint green open shirt over cream T-shirt, no scarf. Reference image 2 is ONLY a reference for narrative staging: a relatable little person at a desk surrounded by distracting devices in a dark cozy study. Do not copy its black-haired character, text, logos, social media UI, or watermark.

Make an original coherent illustration of the brown-haired character sitting behind a wooden desk, centered slightly right, between a dark laptop on the left and a smaller monitor on the right, with a phone lying on the desk foreground right. Warm desk lamp at upper left, shelves and a curtained window in a dark navy study behind. Desk surface across lower third, comfortable grounded perspective. The character is a complete anatomically connected drawing from hair through face, short neck, shoulders, torso, elbows and both hands; natural chibi proportions around 3 heads tall implied, with modest hands and a short neck largely concealed by shirt collar. Every body part belongs to the same drawing and perspective. No enormous pasted head, no disembodied head, no sprite parts, no mannequin.
State A: mildly tired from studying too many things, half-lidded eyes, small worried closed mouth, one hand using the laptop, the other resting flat on the desk. A couple of small glowing message symbols on screens only, plenty of room around the character for later notifications. Emotional storytelling, not smiling for the camera.
Art direction: premium 2D pixel illustration, visible consistent pixel clusters, restrained palette of deep navy, muted teal and warm amber, tactile wood and subtle atmospheric lighting. The entire frame must feel painted together, including the character. Character and laptop remain fully within the central 80% width. Keep bottom 15% quieter/darker for subtitles. No text, numbers, captions, borders, collage panels, perspective UI diagram, infographic or extra person. Fixed camera eye level slightly above the desk, medium-wide shot. This is the master framing to be preserved in later whole-frame pose variants.
